3814bd74607df06e3936e8166e78e007305b1c8e.summary: A BleepingComputer report, citing security firm Sansec, says attackers injected payment-card skimmer code into e-commerce sites and sent stolen card data through Google Apps Script, which online stores often trust, bypassing CSP controls. The report also recalls earlier Google Analytics abuse in Magecart attacks and FIN7's past use of Google services for command and control.
